This was head coach [[Rick Majerus]]'s third season at Saint Louis. The Billikens compete in the [[2009–10 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|Atlantic 10 Conference]] and played their home games at [[Chaifetz Arena]]. They finished the season 23–13, 11–5 in A-10 play and lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2010 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament]]. They were invited to the [[2010 College Basketball Invitational]] where they advanced to the best-of-3 games final.
